data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Husn' which means beauty. The name Hosniya signifies a beautiful and graceful woman in Islamic culture. The name Hosniya carries the meaning “Lady of beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hosniya usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hosniya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hosniya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
